title: Freeports Format Repository Package Manifest
description: Schema for the package.yaml manifest in a freeports format repository.

description.description: Human-readable description of the format repository.

version.description: Version of the format repository contents.

validation_sha256.description: Hash of the hashes of every file a grant covers: certification, not identity.

sha256.description: Identity fingerprints of the parts that produce data; when one moves, info.version must move.

content.description: Hash of the hashes of every file under content/.

metadata.description: Hash of the hashes of every file under metadata/.

tests.description: Hash of the hashes of every file under tests/formats/ — the sha256 of tests/formats.sha256.
